headline: Lyon lead France, yet Hoffenheim are the favourites
summary: Lyon travel to Sinsheim top of the French league and with a perfect Europa League record — 6 points from their European games. Hoffenheim have 0 so far, but ended a run of defeats by winning 2-1 at Gladbach on Sunday, and the market average makes them 47.2% favourites against Lyon's 28.8%. Lyon are without Loïs Openda, 823 minutes this season, the heaviest workload on their absence list. The handicap rates Hoffenheim 0.4 goals better — just under half a goal, a narrow gap rather than control. Both teams to score is priced at 64.5%.
read: Lyon come in top of Ligue 1 and with two wins from two in the Europa League, but it is Hoffenheim — still without a point in Europe — who are the narrow home favourites, rated about half a goal the better side. The market expects goals rather than a cagey night, with both teams to score at 64.5% and Hoffenheim's recent home games all ending 2-3.
